analogy.rationale: MGLL (monoacylglycerol lipase) is a serine hydrolase that degrades 2-arachidonoylglycerol, so its inhibition is expected to overlap most with other lipid-metabolizing enzyme inhibitors such as FAAH and general lipase inhibitors, though transcriptional consequences in these cell lines are likely modest. Cannabinoid receptor ligands are downstream of the same endocannabinoid pathway but act on receptors these cells express at low levels, so similarity is lower.
